title: Terraform module: KMS/HSM bindings and Secrets ops for Private deployments
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a reusable Terraform module to: (1) bind Redwood Private deployment components to customer-managed KMS keys or CloudHSM-backed keys, (2) provision the IAM roles and grants required for long-running inference services to encrypt/decrypt secrets, and (3) manage Secrets Manager <-> Vault synchronization patterns and automated rotation hooks. This is intended for VPC/on-prem installs where customers either use AWS KMS, AWS CloudHSM, or Vault auto-unseal (via Transit). The module must support import of existing keys, zero-downtime key rotations, and safe state handling for upgrades.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module exposes inputs to select key backend: aws_kms | cloudhsm | vault_transit
Module can import an existing KMS key ARNs or create a new key when requested
CloudHSM path creates HSM cluster resources or returns instructions when HSM is managed externally
IAM policy templates generated by module follow least-privilege and are documented
Secrets synchronization example: AWS Secrets Manager -> HashiCorp Vault (namespaced) validated in test harness
Rotation hook implemented as optional Lambda/container task for AWS and a periodic Vault rotation job for Vault-backed keys
Module upgrade path includes a documented, tested plan for state migrations and key rebindings
Health check outputs: a /health endpoint check script and terraform outputs exposing key metadata and last-rotation timestamps
Automated end-to-end tests pass in CI (plan + apply in a disposable account or mock harness)
tasks: Design module interface and variables (inputs/outputs) and publish to infra/terraform-modules repo
Implement KMS path: key resource, grants, alias, key policy templating
Implement Vault Transit path: policy, role mapping, auto-unseal integration docs
Prototype CloudHSM binding pattern; create caveat flow when customer-managed HSM exists
Add Secrets Manager <-> Vault synchronization example using rotation lambda and reconciliation script
Write unit and integration tests (terragrunt/localstack for KMS flows; Vault docker for transit tests)
Create upgrade/migration playbook and a terraform state import helper script
Security review and threat model session with Security team
Add observability outputs (last_rotation_ts, key_id, key_backend, health_probe_cmd)
Prepare PR and coordinate review with Platform and Security
updates: 2025-11-05: Ticket created by Aisha. Drafted scope after infra/peering call with Solutions Architects. Identified three backend targets (aws_kms, cloudhsm, vault_transit).

2025-11-07: Initial interface proposal posted to Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/infra/pages/49123456/KMS+HSM+Terraform+Module (internal). Requested feedback from Security and PM.

2025-11-10: Spike complete. POC for aws_kms path validated using localstack and awscli; discovered grant lifecycle caveat when rotating CMKs. Documented workaround (use rotation via new key + rebind).

2025-11-12: Design review with Security (Tufan, Mei). Feedback: enforce key policy template that denies DeleteKey, restrict grants to specific service principal and role; require rotation monitoring. Action: add strict policy generator and an opt-in flag for legacy policies.

2025-11-14: Implemented basic Terraform module skeleton in repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-terraform-modules/pull/276. Linked PR above. IAM templates added. Unit tests failing on CloudHSM mock — next: refine HSM handling and add clear docs when HSM is customer-managed.

2025-11-17: Added Vault transit support prototype and a Vault helper script for namespacing secrets. Coordinate with DevEx for including examples in SDK onboarding. Assigned to Marco for production hardening and tests.
notes: Trade-offs considered: full CloudHSM provisioning vs. advisory mode. We prefer advisory for initial rollout to avoid long lead times and hardware constraints; provide a 'bring-your-own-hsm' workflow with automated validation checks. For key rotation we recommend create-new-key + rebind pattern to avoid losing access to previous states. State import helpers will be delivered as shell helpers that call 'terraform import' with id mapping. Observability: export Prometheus metrics via an exporter that polls Vault and AWS KMS for rotation timestamps. Next steps: finish CloudHSM docs, add mock tests, and iterate on PR feedback from Security - expected unblock by 2025-11-20.
